title: admin-gate GET /books/packages and POST /books/import
description: docs/AUDIT_2026-07-30.md line ~378 (rt-01, P1): GET /books/packages and POST /books/import in lexy-app/backend/routers/books.py are auth-gated but not admin-gated, so any authenticated user can enumerate server-side package names and trigger import validation. Apply the existing require_admin pattern (see POST /phrases/seed and /admin/lemma-corrections/*) to both endpoints. New test: lexy-app/backend/tests/test_books_import_admin.py (non-admin -> 403, admin -> unchanged behavior). rt-09 (book CRUD/import endpoint tests) depends on this.

title: phrase extractor drops the reflexive+preposition frame ('sich freuen auf')
description: Known defect, pinned by a strict xfail. lexy-app/backend/tests/test_free_chat_progression.py::test_match_inflected_phrase_matches_canonical is marked xfail(strict=True) because the extractor never yields the canonical 'sich freuen auf'. Measured directly: match_sentence('ich freue mich auf die Reise', 'de') returns ['ich', 'jdn. (Akk) freuen'] — the reflexive pronoun and the governed preposition are dropped, so a reflexive verb pattern collapses to a bare accusative frame and can never match its phrase_table canonical. Fix the extraction in subtitle-scraper/phrase_finder.py so a reflexive+preposition verb pattern produces its full canonical, then REMOVE the xfail mark — strict=True means the suite fails with XPASS once this works, which is the intended signal, not a regression.
